kind: official terms capture - mandatory stay components, no room rate stated
room_type: Any Venetian or Palazzo suite on the published refundable 'Most Flexible Rate' (no nightly minimum stay)
occupancy: 2 adults, 1 room (a $50/night charge is added for each additional guest aged 13+)
parking: $20/day self-parking for registered hotel guests, seven days a week; $40/day valet; non-hotel guests $20/day Mon-Thu and $25/day Fri-Sun; poker-room players with 3+ hours of play get that day's self-parking free
cancellation_deadline: 24 hours prior to arrival for the published refundable 'Most Flexible Rate'; prepaid offers are non-cancellable and non-refundable
deposit: A deposit for your stay, including suite, fee, and tax, will be billed upon reservation confirmation. Depending on the offer and reservation, the deposit may be either payment of your first night's stay or prepayment of your entire stay.
incidentals: A credit card incidental deposit of $150 per night is required upon check-in for suite charging privileges for non-Signature Suites.
checkin_checkout: Check-in time is from 3:00 p.m. to 11:59 p.m. on the first day of your reservation. Check-out time is 11:00 a.m. Check-ins prior to 3:00 p.m. and check-outs after 11:00 a.m. are subject to additional fees.
caveats: Derived arithmetic, stated as such: the $55 resort fee 'plus tax' at the Clark County combined 13.38% transient- lodging rate is $62.36 a night, and with the official $20 self-parking fee the mandatory non-room cost of a Venetian stay is $82.36 a night ($576.51 over 7 nights). The room rate itself is still unpublished for these dates, so no true nightly total exists.

The room-tax rate is Clark County's published combined rate for a resort hotel inside the primary gaming corridor; whether a booking engine applies it to the resort fee is shown by the checkout total, not by this row.
Parking is quoted by the property as a daily fee and is not part of the resort fee; the official page says rates are subject to change and that event parking rates may be in effect.
The 24-hour deadline belongs to the published refundable rate, not to a poker suite rate or a prepaid offer: read the deadline on the rate you are actually quoted.
